Description: The BF2 project aims to provide Europe’s spaceport with an application solution that will reliably and securely support the processes involved in creating, distributing, executing and monitoring Operations Analysis and Monitoring Sheets (FASOs). The virtual FASO (Operations Analysis and Monitoring Sheet) Terminals project is an initiative aimed at modernising and optimizing operation coordination processes within the French space agency/Europe’s spaceport. Relying on the principles of Field Service Management (FSM)—namely the management of field interventions, dynamic resource allocation, and real-time activity tracking—this project is part of a continuous-improvement vision. It leverages the opportunities offered by digitalization to boost operational efficiency, transparency, and safety, while ensuring smooth orchestration of teams and equipment on the ground.
Lot description: The solution expected is a FASO process management application solution, intended to be used by different user groups, both inside and outside the French space agency, in a day-to-day operational context. The solution is not intended to replace existing planning or management systems, but to supplement them, ensuring the continuity of the operational flow linked to the FASOs.

SDU har pt. 6 campusser, hvor den største campus er placeret i Odense. De resterende 5 campusser er placeret i Esbjerg, Kolding, Vejle, Sønderborg og København. SDU har derudover en række mindre lokationer rundt omkring i Danmark, samt i Flensburg, Tyskland. Der kan læses mere om alle SDU’s lokationer på www.sdu.dk.
